description: This Java class 'ConnectivityChecker' monitors network connectivity status within an Android environment. It checks available networks, reports when specific network types (cellular or Ethernet) connect, and manages a future object indicating overall connectivity status.

classes.name: ConnectivityChecker
classes.description: A class that checks network connectivity status, reports connection events for mobile and Ethernet networks, and maintains a future indicating overall connectivity.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the network connectivity check, reports network connection events, and updates the connectivity future.

methods.name: onDependencyFailed
methods.description: Handles failure in dependencies by setting the exception in the connectivity future.

methods.name: getConnected
methods.description: Returns the GceFuture<Boolean> object representing the connectivity status.
